items.question: A common dry cough is a side effect of which drug class?
items.explanation: ACE inhibitors raise bradykinin, causing dry cough; switch to an ARB if troublesome.

items.question: Which antiarrhythmic is a potassium channel blocker used in many arrhythmias?
items.explanation: Amiodarone is mainly a class III (K+ channel blocker) antiarrhythmic with multi-class actions.

items.question: Which class I antiarrhythmic is used for ventricular arrhythmias during acute MI?
items.explanation: Lidocaine (class Ib) is used IV for ventricular arrhythmias, acting on ischaemic/depolarised tissue.

items.question: Why does amiodarone cause both hypo- and hyperthyroidism?
options: High iodine content and effects on thyroid hormone metabolism
items.explanation: Amiodarone's high iodine load and inhibition of T4-to-T3 conversion can cause either thyroid dysfunction.

items.question: Which drug class reduces mortality in HFrEF: ACEi/ARB, beta-blocker, MRA and?
items.explanation: SGLT2 inhibitors are now a pillar of guideline-directed HFrEF therapy, reducing mortality and hospitalisation.

*PharmaCraft Daily - 28 Nov 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (CVS)
Q: A common dry cough is a side effect of which drug class?
Ans: ACE inhibitors
Why: ACE inhibitors raise bradykinin, causing dry cough; switch to an ARB if troublesome.

🌍 *FMGE* (CVS)
Q: Which antiarrhythmic is a potassium channel blocker used in many arrhythmias?
Ans: Amiodarone
Why: Amiodarone is mainly a class III (K+ channel blocker) antiarrhythmic with multi-class actions.

🩺 *NEET PG* (CVS)
Q: Which class I antiarrhythmic is used for ventricular arrhythmias during acute MI?
Ans: Lignocaine (lidocaine)
Why: Lidocaine (class Ib) is used IV for ventricular arrhythmias, acting on ischaemic/depolarised tissue.

🏥 *INI-CET* (CVS)
Q: Why does amiodarone cause both hypo- and hyperthyroidism?
Ans: High iodine content and effects on thyroid hormone metabolism
Why: Amiodarone's high iodine load and inhibition of T4-to-T3 conversion can cause either thyroid dysfunction.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Paper III: Systemic)
Q: Which drug class reduces mortality in HFrEF: ACEi/ARB, beta-blocker, MRA and?
Ans: SGLT2 inhibitors
Why: SGLT2 inhibitors are now a pillar of guideline-directed HFrEF therapy, reducing mortality and hospitalisation.
